Description.CastKey: Key used to auto-target and cast Golden Burst from the Q slot.
Description.HoldToCast: When enabled, holding the hotkey keeps casting automatically. When disabled, each key press casts once.
Description.TargetAllies: Allow allied units to be selected as targets.
Description.RequireFriendlyTeammates: When enabled, hero targets are ignored when they are not currently allies.
Description.TargetMonsters: Allow non-boss monsters to be selected as targets.
Description.TargetBosses: Allow elites, minibosses, and bosses to be selected as targets.
Description.SkipDamageImmuneMonsters: When enabled, monster targets are ignored while they have damage immunity.
Description.TargetStones: Allow gold, dream dust, and other stone targets to be selected.
